summary: Plan review gate before ready mark
pull_request_body:
The implement job marks a pull request ready when the checks pass, with no review of the diff against the issue, the plan and the project rules. This change runs `devops review` and a plan-conformance check after the last task group and before `gh pr ready`. A high-severity finding gets one repair round; a finding that survives blocks the ready mark and the item is Blocked. The pull request comment lists every finding with its disposition. The review call budget per item is stated in the settings and enforced, and the ready mark waits for both the checks and the review. The review output is the seam that the draft evaluator reads.

Change: `openspec/changes/3049-the-implement-job-reviews-its-own/`
why: The implement job marks a pull request ready with no review of the diff against the issue, the plan and the project rules, and the review tools the project already has are unused by the job (#3049).
what_changes: Add `src/devops_cli/roadmap/implement_review.py` with the review run, the plan-conformance check and the disposition of each finding.
Gate `_ready` in `src/devops_cli/roadmap/implement_run.py` on both the checks and the review.
Add the `roadmap.implement.review_runs` setting and enforce it as the review call budget per item.
Post every finding and its disposition in the implement comment.
Add the review step names and messages.
Add a replay test with a seeded high-severity finding, and tests for the budget and the ready gate.
Add the `roadmap-implement-review` capability spec delta and update the implement job docs.
The change fits one pull request.
feasibility: `read_file` on `src/devops_cli/roadmap/implement_run.py` lines 642-699 showed `_checks` raising `_StopError` unless the watch is READY, then `_ready` calling `mark_ready` at once: the review has no place between them today.

`file_symbols` on `src/devops_cli/roadmap/implement_pull.py` showed `mark_ready(repo, pull)`, `watch_pull(repo, pull, head)` and `failed_log(repo, check)` as the pull-request seams the job already uses.
`search_code` for `ready_to_mark` showed `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_ready.py` as the single decision function of the stage-ready row, so the review result plugs into an existing seam.
`read_file` on `src/devops_cli/roadmap/implement_run.py` lines 505-520 showed `repair_rounds` bounding the scoped and check repairs: the review budget follows the same shape.
existing_tool: `devops review` (ADR 0005) already produces the findings from pinned tools, advisories, confirmed version facts and the rule pack, and `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_ready.py` already holds the one decision function for the ready mark. The change wires both into the implement job and builds no scanner and no review engine of its own; the plan-conformance check reads the change folder and is a few dozen lines. Building a review engine would cost the pinned tools, a sandbox, a canary per language and the rule pack, weeks of work and a permanent maintenance load, and ADR 0005 rejected exactly that.

decisions.decision: Run the review after the last task group and the push, before `gh pr ready`, and gate `_ready` on it
decisions.reason: The review must see the final head, and the issue requires the ready mark to wait for both the checks and the review.

decisions.decision: Treat a high-severity finding as repaired after one fix step and a re-run, and block the item when it survives
decisions.reason: CONTEXT.md's Implementing definition allows at most one fix step, so the job gets one chance to fix before it blocks.

decisions.decision: State the review budget as two runs per item in the `roadmap.implement.review_runs` setting
decisions.reason: One initial run and one re-run after the repair round bound the cost, and the setting makes the budget visible and enforceable.

decisions.decision: Write the review result as the input of `ready_to_mark` in `src/devops_cli/roadmap/stage_ready.py`
decisions.reason: That function is already the one seam of the ready decision, and #2867 replaces its body without touching a caller.

decisions.decision: Post one comment line per finding with its disposition, under the existing comment marker
decisions.reason: The implement comment already carries the outcome of each step, and one marker keeps a single comment per run.

rejected.alternative: Block the item at the first high-severity finding with no repair round
rejected.evidence: CONTEXT.md's Implementing definition gives at most one fix step, so a fixable finding would stop an item that the job could repair.

rejected.alternative: Run the review only after `gh pr ready`, as an advisory
rejected.evidence: The issue's acceptance criterion says the ready mark waits for both the checks and the review, and that a high-severity finding blocks the ready mark.

rejected.alternative: Let the job call `devops review` without a budget
rejected.evidence: The issue requires the review call budget per item to be stated and enforced, and ADR 0005 records that extra review calls did not raise precision.

rejected.alternative: Build a review engine into the implement job
rejected.evidence: ADR 0005 already moved findings to pinned tools, advisories, confirmed facts and the rule pack, and `devops review` ships them.

specs.purpose: The implement job reviews its own diff and its plan conformance before it marks the pull request ready, within a stated call budget.

added.name: Review runs before the ready mark
added.text: The implement job SHALL run `devops review` on the item's diff and a plan-conformance check after the last task group and before it marks the pull request ready.

scenarios.name: Review runs after the last task group
scenarios.when: the implement job finishes the last task group of the item
scenarios.then: the job runs `devops review` on the diff and the plan-conformance check, and no ready mark happens before both return

scenarios.name: Seeded high-severity finding is repaired
scenarios.when: a replay test seeds a high-severity finding in the diff and the fix step clears it
scenarios.then: the job re-runs the review and marks the pull request ready

added.name: A surviving high-severity finding blocks the ready mark
added.text: The implement job SHALL run one repair round for a high-severity finding, and MUST NOT mark the pull request ready while a high-severity finding stays open.

scenarios.name: Seeded high-severity finding survives the repair round
scenarios.when: a replay test seeds a high-severity finding that the fix step does not clear
scenarios.then: the job stops the item, records the reason and leaves the pull request a draft

scenarios.name: Checks pass but a review finding stays open
scenarios.when: every check passed and the review still holds an open high-severity finding
scenarios.then: the pull request stays a draft

added.name: The comment lists every finding with its disposition
added.text: The implement job SHALL post each review finding in the pull request comment with its disposition: repaired, suppressed or blocking.

scenarios.name: Findings listed with their disposition
scenarios.when: the review completes with one or more findings
scenarios.then: the pull request comment holds one line for each finding with its location, its severity and its disposition

added.name: The review call budget is stated and enforced
added.text: The implement job SHALL limit the review runs per item to `roadmap.implement.review_runs` and MUST stop the review with the budget reason when the limit is reached.

scenarios.name: Budget is spent
scenarios.when: the review reaches the number of runs of `roadmap.implement.review_runs` with a high-severity finding still open
scenarios.then: the job stops the review and blocks the item with the reason that the review budget was spent

scenarios.name: Budget is one initial run and one re-run

added.name: The ready mark waits for the checks and the review
added.text: The implement job SHALL mark the pull request ready only when every check passed and the review holds no unresolved high-severity finding.

scenarios.name: Both gates pass
scenarios.when: every check passed and the review holds no unresolved high-severity finding
scenarios.then: the job marks the pull request ready and sets Status In Review
